units.source_text: 那是一座壮丽的山门，被火包围是最合适不过了。

en.t: It was a magnificent temple gate, and nothing could have suited it better than being surrounded by fire.

units.source_text: 在这样一个明媚的下午，大概不可能看见火吧。

en.t: On such a bright afternoon, one probably could not have seen the flames.

units.source_text: 于是它被大量的浓烟所包围，看不见的火焰舔着天空的情景，只有透过望及的苍穹歪歪扭扭地摇晃着才晓得的吧。

en.t: And so it would be wrapped in thick clouds of smoke; the sight of invisible flames licking the sky could only be known from the way the visible blue heavens wavered and twisted.
